title_zh: 江苏出台12项措施加力支持工业企业技术改造
title_en: Jiangsu Issues 12 Measures to Boost Technological Upgrading of Industrial Enterprises
summary_zh: 江苏省政府办公厅近日印发《关于加力支持工业企业技术改造的若干措施》，通过给资金、优服务，支持工业企业增资扩产、技术改造和设备更新。
summary_en: The Jiangsu Provincial Government Office recently issued measures to support technological upgrading of industrial enterprises, offering funding and improved services for capacity expansion, technical transformation and equipment renewal.
